Francine’s home. 💙🐾

After weeks of searching, with thermal drones, video surveillance, and the help of the Richmond, VA community, Francine, the beloved cat of Lowe’s Store 1037, has been found safe and sound.

When Francine went missing in mid September, the store team and neighbors refused to give up. With the support of expert trackers, everyone worked together to bring her home. The search even stretched 85 miles away to a Lowe’s distribution center in North Carolina, where she was finally spotted on camera.

At 4 a.m., two Lowe’s associates made the drive to reunite with her, and when Francine jumped into their arms, she let out one big meow, as if to say, “What took you so long?” For the team and community who never stopped looking, that moment said it all.

Welcome home, Francine, the legend, the mascot, and the heart of Store 1037 💙. https://t.co/Ba6DTm8cej
